svg.title: Computer-use automation system architecture (after review v2)
svg.desc: A goal enters sandbox discovery against Dolibarr, a real ERP/CRM running in Docker. The discovery orchestrator exchanges scoped page observations and one proposed action per turn with a model API reached through one swappable adapter, and records an execution trace. A compiler turns the trace into a versioned capability artifact plus an app profile of screen states, handlers and commit routes; a tests.json suite validates it and a reviewer who is not the author approves its lock hash. A calling agent invokes the approved capability through a deterministic executor that uses no model and returns one of four statuses: success, business outcome, failure or indeterminate. Both paths send every action through one run runtime: an evidence writer with redaction, a single policy engine, a commit ledger and a control lease. The policy engine is the only path to the surface adapter and the live browser session. A sandbox-only fault layer injects network faults into that session. A human operator takes over the same browser window through an intervention coordinator and a minimal console; the operator's input bypasses the policy engine but not the network allowlist, and is captured.

text.tspan: shared by both paths · one per live session
